skill.name: enact-playwright
skill.description: Run headless Playwright browser automation to capture screenshots, text, or HTML from a target web page.
skill.summary: Automates Chromium page visits for screenshots and content extraction.
skill.author: EnactProtocol

security_audit.summary: The static backtick, filesystem, and documentation URL findings are false positives after context review. Semantic review found meaningful risk from user-controlled command interpolation in SKILL.md and unrestricted browser navigation to caller-supplied URLs.

remediation.issue: User input is interpolated into the skill command string.
remediation.suggestion: Pass arguments through a structured argv mechanism, or validate and escape url, action, and selector before command execution.

remediation.issue: The browser can navigate to any caller-supplied URL.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only http and https URLs, block private and link-local network ranges, and document the network trust boundary.

remediation.issue: HTML and text extraction can return sensitive page content.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to target authenticated or confidential pages unless the output destination is trusted.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 16 is a JavaScript template literal used only in console.log. It does not invoke a shell or execute external commands.
Line 17 logs the selected action with a JavaScript template literal. There is no child process, shell, or command execution sink.
Line 18 logs the selector value using a JavaScript template literal. This is string interpolation for output, not shell backtick execution.
Line 37 logs the selected browser path with a JavaScript template literal. It does not execute the interpolated value as a command.
Line 47 logs the navigation target with a JavaScript template literal. The template literal is not an external command execution primitive.
The directory read is limited to the hardcoded /ms-playwright browser install path. It does not read user-controlled paths or workspace data.
The existence check targets the fixed /ms-playwright directory to locate Chromium. This is a bounded runtime setup check, not access to user files.
Line 46 starts a Markdown bash code fence in documentation. It is not executable code inside the skill runtime.
The URL on line 48 is example.com in a usage example. It documents how to pass a URL and is not a hidden network destination.
The URL on line 51 is example.com in screenshot documentation. It is illustrative and not a runtime callback or exfiltration endpoint.
The URL on line 54 is example.com in a documented selector example. It is not evidence of unauthorized outbound communication.

semantic_findings.title: User-Controlled Shell Command Interpolation
semantic_findings.description: The skill command inserts url, action, and selector values directly into a command string. If the runner evaluates this through a shell, a crafted quote in user input could alter command execution inside the container.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command field shows direct interpolation of three user-controlled parameters into single-quoted command arguments. Confidence is high, but exact exploitability depends on how the Enact runner escapes command templates.

semantic_findings.title: Unrestricted User-Supplied URL Navigation
semantic_findings.description: The script accepts a URL argument and passes it to page.goto without scheme, host, or private-network restrictions. This can enable SSRF-like access from the execution environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The URL is read directly from process arguments and used as the browser navigation target. Browser automation legitimately needs network access, but unrestricted targets create a clear abuse path.

content.value_statement: Manual page checks slow down web testing and content review. This skill opens pages in Chromium and returns screenshots, text, or HTML.
actual_capabilities: Navigates to a supplied URL with headless Chromium.
Captures full-page screenshots and returns base64 output.
Extracts text from the full page or a CSS selector.
Extracts inner HTML from the selected element.
Uses playwright-core with the Microsoft Playwright container image.
Applies a 30 second page navigation timeout.
limitations: It does not click buttons, fill forms, or run multi-step browser flows.
It does not authenticate to sites or manage browser sessions.
Screenshot output is returned as base64 text, not as a saved image file.
Invalid selectors or blocked pages surface as Playwright errors.

use_cases.title: Capture Regression Evidence
use_cases.description: Take a full-page screenshot of a staging page for review before release.

use_cases.title: Extract Page Copy
use_cases.description: Collect visible text from a public page or a selected element for analysis.

use_cases.title: Inspect Rendered Markup
use_cases.description: Retrieve inner HTML from a page section to debug rendered output.

prompt_templates.title: Get Page Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check for visible page content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the target web page and return the visible text from the body.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a Screenshot
prompt_templates.scenario: Visual review of a public page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Navigate to the supplied URL and capture a full-page screenshot for review.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Specific Element
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused extraction with a CSS selector.
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the page and return the text from the main heading selector.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Rendered HTML
prompt_templates.prompt: Navigate to the page and return the inner HTML for the selected component container.

output_examples.input: Request text from the body of a public landing page.
output_examples.output: The skill returns the visible body text after the page finishes loading.

output_examples.input: Request a screenshot of a documentation page.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a full-page screenshot as base64 text between clear start and end markers.

output_examples.input: Request HTML from a selected product card.
output_examples.output: The skill returns the selected element inner HTML for inspection.

best_practices: Use public or approved test URLs unless confidential access is required.
Prefer narrow CSS selectors when extracting text or HTML.
Review screenshot and HTML output before sharing it outside your team.
anti_patterns: Do not target internal network hosts without explicit authorization.
Do not pass secrets, tokens, or credentials inside page URLs.
Do not use this skill for complex browser workflows that require clicks or login state.

faq.question: What browser does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Chromium through playwright-core in the Microsoft Playwright container image.

faq.question: Can it take screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. The screenshot action captures a full-page image and returns base64 text.

faq.question: Can it extract only one element?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a CSS selector to target text or HTML extraction.

faq.question: Does it support clicking or form entry?
faq.answer: No. This version supports navigation, screenshots, text extraction, and HTML extraction only.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The generated metadata marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I avoid when using it?
faq.answer: Avoid private targets and sensitive pages unless you control the output and have authorization.
